lines.text: Danger is always around the corner.
Just give me the signal and I'll move.
I will protect you, no matter what happens.
I'm preparing for every possibility during our time together.
Would you like a bowl of ramen before you leave?

This awkward silence is killing me.
Shall I give you an updated report?
Keep your guard up, even at the Outpost.
Moving like this is much better than standing still.
Armament check. I'll be part of your platoon from here on out.
Thank you for caring about me.
A gift? I... I didn't expect this.
This is... all a bit overwhelming...
I will do all I can to repay you.
You're so affectionate towards me... it's heartwarming.
You have won my respect. I will follow you wherever you go.
One moment. Allow me to finish one personal assignment.
I've still got some fight in me.
I'll draw them in this direction!
